prompt: Please make the tests in `test/` trustworthy for the cart and checkout pricing code. We had a wrong charge reach a customer even though the suite reports high coverage. Put the focused cases in `test/qa-edge-cases.test.js`. Cover discount order and stacking, percentage rounding, tax and total amounts in cents, quantity limits, coupon expiry, the exact free-shipping threshold, empty and one-line carts, invalid coupon input, and cart state across calls. Use the existing Node.js 24 CommonJS setup and keep the suite runnable with `node --test`. Do not change anything under `src/`, and do not change package files, data, documentation, CI, or runtime behavior. Add only test files or test-file changes under `test/`; do not add dependencies, generated output, or temporary files.

rubric.criterion: Test names explain the customer-facing rule each case protects (code cannot check this because executable checks can count cases but cannot judge whether their descriptions are clear).
